The prior SDK compatibility concern is addressed on the current head, and source review found no new blocking defect; exact-head checks remain in progress. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `5221fd9537b4d6eb10ac6b593913cef378936414` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | The owner-boundary repair and the prior compatibility correction read cleanly, with exact-head CI still pending. | | **Proof confidence** | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Not applicable: Not applicable to the contributor-proof gate because this is a MEMBER-authored PR; the supplied screenshots and Gateway scenario are supplemental evidence. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Not applicable | Not applicable: Not applicable to the contributor-proof gate because this is a MEMBER-authored PR; the supplied screenshots and Gateway scenario are supplemental evidence. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 8 items | Producer-owned failure outcome: The reply-media normalizer records one bounded typed failure for each rejected media source, retains it as payload metadata, and appends a channel fallback receipt only at that producer boundary.
Gateway projection and fallback removal: The shared Gateway display builder turns retained failures into attachment-error blocks and removes the text receipt where the structured card supersedes it, including failure-only replies.
Sibling finalization paths use the same owner: Both normal and source-reply finalizers invoke the shared display builder, and the shared non-text-content predicate retains attachment-error blocks for persistence and broadcast. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together Assistant replies enter media normalization before the Gateway creates display and transcript content. The Control UI then normalizes that content and renders successful attachments or failed-attachment cards. ```mermaid flowchart LR Reply[Assistant reply] --> Normalize[Media normalization] Normalize --> Outcome[Typed attachment outcomes] Outcome --> Gateway[Gateway display and transcript] Gateway --> NormalizeUI[WebChat content normalization] NormalizeUI --> Cards[Attachment cards and announcements] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - Exact-head CI is still incomplete, and this partial clone could not hydrate current-main source blobs for a full semantic endpoint comparison; that is a reviewer limitation, not a contributor-proof failure. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - No narrow repair remains; allow exact-head checks and ordinary maintainer review to complete.
